about_the_game:
Lead a team of roped climbers across a vast landscape of summits. Explore and unlock new areas peppered with outrageous climbing locations. Play with friends or by yourself, and climb, swing, explode, crash, fall, break, and catapult (literally) your way to the top.

Demo Available Now!

Get a taste of the action with the early demo, and follow along as the adventure expands with more climbs, new mechanics, and wild surprises later this year!

Fail Upwards in the Ultimate Climbing Adventure!

Grab your ropes, chalk up and launch yourself on a chaotic climbing adventure like no other! Whether playing solo or in co-op, control a team of two climbers and tackle every summit, overcoming unpredictable challenges filled with laughs, mishaps and glorious moments of triumph.

Explore all Sorts of Crazy Landscapes

From towering cliffs to frozen peaks, crumbling ruins to gravity-defying temples, your journey will take you through a world built for adventure. Discover outrageous climbing spots, uncover hidden routes, and push the limits of vertical exploration.

Climb, Jump, Swing, Crash... And Climb Again!

Master a dynamic climbing system that rewards skill—and embraces failure. Whether you're swinging across gaps, launching yourself (or your teammates) to new heights, or spectacularly tumbling back down, every climb is an unpredictable experience.

Go It Alone or Rope in Your Friends

Team up with friends in cooperative multiplayer or challenge yourself solo. Coordinate your movements, catch each other’s falls, and experience the joy (and chaos) of roped teamwork. Just remember: success is optional, but fun is guaranteed.
